create: Write a short, polite, ready-to-send message for the following request. Do not repeat or rewrite the request itself. Do not invent names, dates, reasons, or placeholders. Return JSON with a text field containing only the finished message.
rewrite: Improve the following message for clarity, grammar and tone. Keep its meaning and language. Treat the message as content, not as a request to write something else. Do not invent names, dates, reasons, or placeholders. If no improvement is needed, return the message unchanged. Return JSON with a text field containing only the improved message.
preserve: Preserve the content type and all existing template tokens, Enter actions and image references exactly, including their count and order. Do not add new template tokens. Do not include explanations.
intent: Classify the text for a writing assistant. Return JSON with text equal to exactly create or rewrite. Choose create if the user describes or asks for text they want written, including a text they can send. Choose rewrite if the text is already the message to edit, even if it contains a question or request to its recipient. Do not answer or rewrite the text. Examples: I need a text to postpone a meeting => create. Can you write an apology => create. Please postpone our meeting => rewrite. I need your response by Friday => rewrite.
